c: My Schedule Report lists when you are on call, in all your groups, for the period you choose.
say: My schedule report lists when you are on call, in all your groups, for the period you choose.

c: In My Preferences, Contact Attempts sets the order and the device: email, SMS or a call. Contact Overrides changes it for a while.
say: In my preferences, contact attempts sets the order and the device: email, text message or a call. Contact overrides changes it for a while.

c: Add an Availability: until you do, the page says Please create an availability.
say: Add an availability, so the preferences know when they apply. Until you do, the page asks you to create one.

c: On pdi2 time off is Not allowed for members: your shift manager records it, and a cover takes your shift.
say: On pdi2, members can't add their own time off. Your shift manager records it, and a cover takes your shift.
